issues.title: feat: carry acceptance gates
issues.body:
Wire the acceptance block into the planner.

## 対象ファイル
- `src/gates.ts`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] the block is parsed
- [ ] the ids reach the plan

```acceptance-gates
# the notation's own comment form: a `#` at column 0, on its own line
version: 1
require:
  - verify-selftest
  - orchestrate-fixtures
```

## Verification

```bash
python3 scripts/validate.py
node tests/fixtures/cmate-orchestrate/run_tests.mjs
```

Also run `pytest -q` before pushing.
